title: Software Tester – QA & Test Automation (AI-first)
description:
**Break it before our customers do.**

tuck is virtual try-on and fit intelligence for fashion brands in India and globally. Shoppers see the real garment on their own photo and get a size from the brand’s own size chart. We’re growing our engineering team in Kochi.

In this role, you’ll own testing for everything tuck ships: our app, try-on technology and engineering. You’ll find issues early, report them clearly, and use AI tools to automate as much testing as possible.

**What you’ll do**

* Test the tuck app, storefront widget, dashboards and APIs on desktop and mobile
* Check AI outputs, such as try-on image quality and size recommendations
* Write clear test cases and bug reports, and follow each bug through to its fix
* Build and maintain automated tests using AI tools
* Run regression checks before every release

**What you bring**

* A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field
* At least 1 year of hands-on software testing experience
* Working knowledge of Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or similar tools
* Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your work
* **Curiosity:** you want to know why things break
* **You dive deep:** you find the root cause, not just the symptom
* **An obsession with learning:** you pick up new tools fast, on your own
* **You’re highly organised:** your test cases and bug reports are always clear and up to date

**What you earn**

* ₹15,000–20,000 a month, based on experience and level

**Good to know**

* Office-based at Kinfra Hi-Tech Park, Kalamassery, Kochi
* You must currently live in Kochi
* We expect a highly automated way of working, with AI tools used every day
* We especially encourage women to apply

**Job type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** Software testing: 1 year (Required)  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala (Required)  
**Work location:** In person

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
MidSource Consulting Pvt Ltd is looking for QA Automation Engineers with **3 to 5 years** of hands-on experience in **test automation** using Selenium with Java and/or Playwright.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications.
* Perform functional, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Design, develop, and maintain automation test frameworks.
* Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with development teams.
* Analyse test results and prepare test execution reports.
* Collaborate with QA and development teams to improve test coverage and software quality.
* Participate in test planning and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes.

Required Skills

* 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on QA automation.
* Practical experience with Selenium WebDriver and Java and/or Playwright.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Experience writing, debugging, and maintaining automated test scripts.
* Familiarity with Git, defect tracking tools, and test management processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Experience with API testing, SQL, and CI/CD tools is an added advantage.

Engagement Options

* Full-time and contract opportunities may be available, depending on project requirements.
* Work arrangements may vary between remote, hybrid, and client-site engagements.

Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resumes, highlighting their automation testing experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and preferred engagement and work arrangements.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* 1. How many years of hands-on QA automation experience do you have?
* 2. Which automation tools have you used in a real project?
* 3. What is your current annual CTC (₹ LPA)?
* 4. What is your expected annual CTC (₹ LPA)?
* 5. What is your current notice period / earliest joining date?
* 6. Which engagement type would you consider? (Full-time/Contract/Both)
* 7. Which work arrangement would you consider? (Remote/Hybrid/Onsite/Any)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala

title: Software Quality Assurance & Test Automation Intern
description:
### **Ensure Software Quality | Detect Defects | Build Reliable Applications**

### **Job Description**

Wahy Lab Solutions is seeking detail-oriented and analytical candidates for the position of Software Quality Assurance & Test Automation Intern. The role involves evaluating software applications, identifying defects, validating functionality, and ensuring application quality through systematic testing practices. Interns will gain practical exposure to manual testing, test case design, defect tracking, regression testing, and automation testing concepts through industry-oriented projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse software requirements and prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Execute manual test cases to validate application functionality and usability.
* Identify, document, track, and report software defects and inconsistencies.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and compatibility testing.
* Verify bug fixes and ensure previously working features remain stable.
* Assist in developing and executing automated test scripts.
* Conduct API testing and validate application responses and data.
* Support web application testing across different browsers and devices.
* Use bug tracking and test management tools to monitor testing progress.
* Collaborate with developers and project teams to investigate and resolve defects.
* Maintain test documentation, defect reports, and quality assurance records.
* Participate in software quality assurance activities throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

### **Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), and testing methodologies.
* Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Understanding of manual testing techniques and test case design.
* Familiarity with functional, regression, integration, and usability testing.
* Basic knowledge of bug reporting and defect life cycle management.
* Awareness of automation testing tools such as Selenium or Playwright is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of API testing tools such as Postman is preferred.
* Familiarity with Jira or other defect tracking tools is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in Software Testing, Quality Assurance, and Test Automation are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: Software Quality Assurance & Test Automation Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* Software Test Engineer
* Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer
* Manual Test Engineer
* Automation Test Engineer
* QA Analyst
* Software Quality Analyst

### **Why Join Us?**

* Complete QA Lifecycle Exposure: Gain hands-on experience across the entire Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis to final defect verification.
* Modern Test Automation: Learn foundational concepts of automated testing frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, and Postman API validation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work directly with development and product teams inside real agile software release pipelines.
* Strong Quality Foundation: Build a practical, industry-standard QA portfolio to fast-track your career as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer.

### **Apply Now and Start Building Your Career in Software Quality Assurance!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume on hr@wahylab.com
